question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Turbulent
solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. 'Violent.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Turbulent
 involving a lot of sudden changes, arguments, or violence. (बहुत सारे अचानक परिवर्तन, तर्क या हिंसा शामिल है)
 
 
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options:
 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Ordered
 carefully arranged or controlled. (सावधानीपूर्वक व्यवस्थित या नियंत्रित)
 
 

 Peaceful
 without violence. (हिंसा के बिना)
 
 

 Non-violent
 not involving fighting or the use of physical force. (लड़ाई या शारीरिक बल के उपयोग को शामिल नहीं करना)
 
 

 Violent
 sudden and powerful; using force to hurt or attack. (अचानक और शक्तिशाली; चोट या हमला करने के लिए बल का प्रयोग करना)
 
 
 
 

 

 
• Clearly, the word 'Violent' is closest in meaning to the given word 'Turbulent.'
 
• Therefore, the correct synonym of the given word is option 4.
